newsitems.title: Introducing ECC: REDLINE
newsitems.author: NetEaseGamesStaff
newsitems.contents: NetEase Games has unveiled ECC: REDLINE, a competitive FPS built around extreme sports. Bringing fluid movement, tactical abilities, and responsive gunplay into the same arena, the game gives players more ways to create openings, turn the tide, and compete for the championship.The official reveal and gameplay trailers offer a first look at its world and the action at the heart of every match.Watch the reveal trailer:Watch the gameplay trailer:Welcome to the Extreme Circuit ChampionshipECC stands for Extreme Circuit Championship, a new-generation tactical survival tournament. As a manager, you work closely with athletes from around the world and lead them toward the championship trophy.Set in a near-future world, the tournament is organized by IESA (International Extreme Sports Alliance), bringing advanced technology and extreme sports together in a new form of competition. Tactical Athletes enter the arena with distinct tactical abilities, where movement, marksmanship, and teamwork all contribute to the result.Faster Action and More Ways to Turn the TideECC: REDLINE combines a faster combat pace with smoother controls and more opportunities to recover from setbacks. Tactical athletes, weapon customization, and in-match progression give squads the flexibility to adapt as the competition unfolds.Each match follows a clear rhythm: drop into the arena, gather equipment, engage opponents, earn credits, and strengthen your loadout as you work toward the final showdown. Every movement choice and every shot can change the course of the match.Five core features shape the experience.Enter the Circuit, Own the EdgeThe action begins as soon as your athlete enters the arena. Loot supplies, contest key positions, upgrade your equipment, and advance with your squad as the safe zone closes in.Choosing when to engage and where to position your team is part of the competition. Players are encouraged to create opportunities through active combat and coordinated decisions.Extreme Motion, Instant ImpactSprint, slide, aim, and fire in one seamless flow. Movement and shooting work together, allowing players to reposition quickly and turn an opening into an advantage.Grappling movement, wall bounces, and wingsuit dives expand your options for navigating the arena. How you approach a fight can be just as decisive as how accurately you shoot.Exit Denied, Back in PlayBeing eliminated does not necessarily end your round. Return mechanics give athletes opportunities to rejoin the battlefield, regroup with their teammates, and get back into the action.As long as your squad is still standing, there is room for a comeback. Staying coordinated helps your team recover and make the most of another chance.Earn More, Hit HarderTake down opponents and complete objectives to earn in-match credits. Spend them to buy equipment, upgrade weapons, and reinforce your armor during the match.Combat feeds directly into progression, giving squads new options as they earn resources. Decide what to upgrade and when to invest, then adapt your equipment to the next encounter.Elite Athletes, Endless TacticsEach athlete brings a distinct role and tactical abilities to the squad. Combine their strengths to build a team that can push forward, hold a position, support teammates, or respond to changing conditions.A well-timed ability can create an opening, but coordinated follow-through turns it into a winning play. Across a four-person squad, movement, gunplay, and tactical decisions work together in the pursuit of the title.Stay tuned for future beta test announcements.
